text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув fails to win the Hanshin
Juvenile
Fillies. Her ambition
undeterred, she vows to use
this loss as
fuel for her next race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since the race.
The world
at large is abuzz with debate,
wondering which
race Эйр Грув will
run in next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув wishes to become a shining
beacon
that all Umamusume aspire
toward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to achieve that, she firmly
announces
that she will be running in the
Tiara tour: the Oka
Sho, the Japanese
Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
